references.text: Unleavened bread is also mentioned in connection with the Passover meal, where the Israelites were commanded to eat the meat with unleavened bread
Unleavened bread is used in the sacrificial service, as Gideon was instructed to place the meat and the unleavened cakes on the rock
Manoah also offered a burnt offering on a rock to the Lord, similar to Gideon's offering on the rock
Elijah poured water over the sacrifice on the altar, just as Gideon was told to pour out the broth
Unleavened cakes are mentioned as part of the grain offering, which connects to the unleavened cakes that Gideon presented
